target_customer: Healthcare AI automation companies and engineering teams that need reliable payer portal and EHR browser automations
problem: Custom browser scripts against payer portals and EHRs break often and need constant maintenance.
business_model: Developer platform usage-based pricing for managed browser automation

founders.name: Adrian Ziegler
founders.background_notes: Background not found in opened sources.

founders.name: Felix Martin Eckert
founders.background_notes: A directory snippet lists SylphAI, Picus Capital and Capgemini but I did not open it, so not recorded.

technical_complexity.rationale: Generating deterministic workflows and self-healing against changing portals, plus HIPAA infrastructure, is moderately hard engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Many agent browser tools exist; accumulated workflows for payer portals create some lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; a vendor blog compares CloudCruise with Skyvern in 2026.

market_need_then: Healthcare administrative workflows such as eligibility checks and prior authorization depend on portals without APIs; no dated demand evidence from 2024 was found.

identity.visual_style: Bold headlines with product UI mockups
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, direct, aimed at engineering leaders

brand_strength.rationale: Name is easily confused with Cruise the robotaxi company in search results and no brand press exists.

outcome_analysis: CloudCruise is active and announced a $5M seed in March 2026 about two years after YC W24. It sells a self-healing builder and maintenance agent for healthcare browser automations to AI automation companies. Traction is described only in company terms, so success is not yet established.
notes: Seed confirmed by the company blog; Distill Intelligence and SignalBase snippets match. CB Insights shows $500K only, treated as stale. Dated competitor search returned only generic vendor pages from later periods, so the list is empty. Outcome search results were all about Cruise the robotaxi firm and found nothing on CloudCruise.
